_comment: THE ONLY CONTENT SOURCE (owner order Aug 3): every post and reel comes from these X accounts and nowhere else - the wide-net topic searches, Reddit, news feeds and the platform scout are all DELETED. radar_x.py batches these handles into from:-OR searches with a min_faves floor, so we only pay for tweets that are ALREADY viral - adding accounts is nearly free.
